```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(ggplot2)
```

# Dataset Summary

```{r summary}
stats_df <- data.frame(
  Metric = c("Total Sequences", "Mean Length (nt)", "Median Length (nt)",
             "Min Length (nt)", "Max Length (nt)", "Mean GC Content",
             "Total Nucleotides", "Motif Length Analysed",
             "Unique k-mers Found", "k-mers After Filter"),
  Value = c(
    2, 6.5, 6.0, 6, 7,
    sprintf("%.1f%%", 0.333 * 100),
    format(13, big.mark = ","),
    3, 5, 2
  )
)
kable(stats_df, caption = "Dataset Overview", booktabs = TRUE)
```

# Top Motifs

```{r motifs}
top_df <- head(motif_table, 20)[, c("kmer","total_count","seq_frequency",
                                     "enrichment_score","p_adjusted","significant")]
top_df$seq_frequency <- round(top_df$seq_frequency, 3)
top_df$enrichment_score <- round(top_df$enrichment_score, 3)
top_df$p_adjusted <- formatC(top_df$p_adjusted, format = "e", digits = 2)
colnames(top_df) <- c("k-mer","Total Count","Seq Freq","Enrichment","Adj p","Sig")
kable(top_df, caption = "Top 20 Motifs by Rank", booktabs = TRUE)
```

# Analysis Parameters

```{r params}
params_df <- data.frame(
  Parameter = c("Input File", "k-mer Length", "Min Sequence Frequency",
                "Min Occurrence Count"),
  Value = c("sample_rna.fasta", 3, 0.10, 1)
)
kable(params_df, caption = "Analysis Parameters", booktabs = TRUE)
```

# Notes

- Enrichment scores are log2 ratios vs. uniform background model (p=0.25 per base).
- P-values computed via one-sided binomial test; Bonferroni corrected.
- Combined rank aggregates frequency, enrichment, and significance ranks.
